cohort: The study included 87,065 deliveries occurring between 2004 and 2015 in ten public hospitals in Styria, Austria, for deliveries at or exceeding 34 + 0 gestational weeks.
finding: Delivery volume and high-volume centers were associated with the highest risk of maternal complications, while time of birth and consultant attendance did not significantly affect outcomes, and midwife-managed deliveries were associated with lower adverse event rates.
